verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ذَوَاتِ ٱلْأَوْتَارِ». مَزْمُورٌ لِدَاوُدَ
verses.en: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of David.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David.

verses.he: בְּקָרְאִ֡י עֲנֵ֤נִי ׀ אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צִדְקִ֗י בַּ֭צָּר הִרְחַ֣בְתָּ לִּ֑י חָ֝נֵּ֗נִי וּשְׁמַ֥ע תְּפִלָּתִֽי׃
verses.ar: عِنْدَ دُعَائِيَ ٱسْتَجِبْ لِي يَا إِلَهَ بِرِّي. فِي ٱلضِّيقِ رَحَّبْتَ لِي. تَرَاءَفْ عَلَيَّ وَٱسْمَعْ صَلَاتِي.
verses.en: Answer me when I call, O God of my righteousness, Thou who didst set me free when I was in distress; be gracious unto me, and hear my prayer.
verses.kjv: Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me [when I was] in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
verses.web: Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

verses.he: בְּנֵ֥י אִ֡ישׁ עַד־מֶ֬ה כְבֹודִ֣י לִ֭כְלִמָּה תֶּאֱהָב֣וּן רִ֑יק תְּבַקְשׁ֖וּ כָזָ֣ב סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: يَا بَنِي ٱلْبَشَرِ، حَتَّى مَتَى يَكُونُ مَجْدِي عَارًا؟ حَتَّى مَتَى تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْبَاطِلَ وَتَبْتَغُونَ ٱلْكَذِبَ؟ سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: O ye sons of men, how long shall my glory be put to shame, in that ye love vanity, and seek after falsehood? Selah
verses.kjv: O ye sons of men, how long [will ye turn] my glory into shame? [how long] will ye love vanity, [and] seek after leasing? Selah.
verses.web: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

verses.he: וּדְע֗וּ כִּֽי־הִפְלָ֣ה יְ֭הוָה חָסִ֣יד לֹ֑ו יְהוָ֥ה יִ֝שְׁמַ֗ע בְּקָרְאִ֥י אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.ar: فَٱعْلَمُوا أَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ قَدْ مَيَّزَ تَقِيَّهُ. ٱلرَّبُّ يَسْمَعُ عِنْدَ مَا أَدْعُوهُ.
verses.en: But know that the LORD hath set apart the godly man as His own; the LORD will hear when I call unto Him.
verses.kjv: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
verses.web: But know that Yahweh has set apart for himself him who is godly; Yahweh will hear when I call to him.

verses.he: רִגְז֗וּ וְֽאַל־תֶּ֫חֱטָ֥אוּ אִמְר֣וּ בִ֭לְבַבְכֶם עַֽל־מִשְׁכַּבְכֶ֗ם וְדֹ֣מּוּ סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: اِرْتَعِدُوا وَلَا تُخْطِئُوا. تَكَلَّمُوا فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ عَلَى مَضَاجِعِكُمْ وَٱسْكُتُوا. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: Tremble, and sin not; commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah
verses.kjv: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
verses.web: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

verses.ar: اِذْبَحُوا ذَبَائِحَ ٱلْبِرِّ، وَتَوَكَّلُوا عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ.
verses.en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
verses.kjv: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
verses.web: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in Yahweh.

verses.he: רַבִּ֥ים אֹמְרִים֮ מִֽי־יַרְאֵ֪נוּ֫ טֹ֥וב נְֽסָה־עָ֭לֵינוּ אֹ֨ור פָּנֶ֬יךָ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.ar: كَثِيرُونَ يَقُولُونَ: «مَنْ يُرِينَا خَيْرًا؟». ٱرْفَعْ عَلَيْنَا نُورَ وَجْهِكَ يَارَبُّ.
verses.en: Many there are that say: 'Oh that we could see some good!' LORD, lift Thou up the light of Thy countenance upon us.
verses.kjv: [There be] many that say, Who will shew us [any] good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
verses.web: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” Yahweh, let the light of your face shine on us.

verses.he: נָתַ֣תָּה שִׂמְחָ֣ה בְלִבִּ֑י מֵעֵ֬ת דְּגָנָ֖ם וְתִֽירֹושָׁ֣ם רָֽבּוּ׃
verses.ar: جَعَلْتَ سُرُورًا فِي قَلْبِي أَعْظَمَ مِنْ سُرُورِهِمْ إِذْ كَثُرَتْ حِنْطَتُهُمْ وَخَمْرُهُمْ.
verses.en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than when their corn and their wine increase.
verses.kjv: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time [that] their corn and their wine increased.
verses.web: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

verses.he: בְּשָׁלֹ֣ום יַחְדָּו֮ אֶשְׁכְּבָ֪ה וְאִ֫ישָׁ֥ן כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה יְהוָ֣ה לְבָדָ֑ד לָ֝בֶ֗טַח תֹּושִׁיבֵֽנִי׃
verses.ar: بِسَلَامَةٍ أَضْطَجِعُ بَلْ أَيْضًا أَنَامُ، لِأَنَّكَ أَنْتَ يَارَبُّ مُنْفَرِدًا فِي طُمَأْنِينَةٍ تُسَكِّنُنِي.
verses.en: In peace will I both lay me down and sleep; for Thou, LORD, makest me dwell alone in safety.
verses.kjv: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
verses.web: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, Yahweh, make me live in safety.
